citations.title: Debutants and first-time medallists as NOCs make history at Milano Cortina 2026 : ANOC

units.text: Component c2 (NOCs competed at 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy): Evidence 3478ba30 span 82, evidence a00ca058 span 92, and evidence 74746fb4 span 57 and 65 all consistently state that 92 or 93 NOCs competed at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy, confirming the assertion's description of participation.

citations.title: Debutants and first-time medallists as NOCs make history at Milano Cortina 2026 : ANOC

judgement.reason: The passages support 92 NOCs competing, but Olympedia's 93 figure refers to 92 nations plus AIN competitors as 93 national entities, not 93 NOCs, so the claimed '92 or 93 NOCs' consistency is not fully accurate.
